input_messages.content: Hello, I’m having some trouble with my phone. I haven’t been able to send those picture messages—MMS, I think they’re called—for the past few hours. I’m not sure what’s wrong, but I’d really like to get it working again. Can you help me with this?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. I hope that’s enough to get started.
Yes, it’s the phone with the number 555-123-2002 that’s having the problem. This is the only phone I use.

I just checked, and it looks like there aren’t any signal bars showing at the top of my screen, and I don’t see any data indicator like 4G or LTE. I also don’t see an airplane icon. What should I do next?

I checked, and it says there’s no SIM card detected in my phone. I’m not sure why that is—should I try taking it out and putting it back in? I get a bit nervous doing things like that. Will I lose anything important if I do this?

Alright, I went ahead and reseated the SIM card like you suggested. Now, I see full signal bars at the top of my screen, and there’s a “5G” symbol showing. It also looks like mobile data is enabled. What should I do next?
I just tried to send a picture message, but it still isn’t working. It won’t let me send it. Is there something else I should try? I’m starting to get a bit frustrated—why is this so complicated?
I checked, and both Wi-Fi Calling and Wi-Fi are turned off on my phone right now. I’m just using mobile data. What should I do next?

I checked my APN settings, and it says the APN name is “internet” and there’s something called an MMSC URL listed as “http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc.” I’m not sure if that’s right or not. Should I still try resetting these settings to default, or is there something else I should do? I get a bit nervous changing things I don’t understand.

I went ahead and reset the APN settings like you suggested. You mentioned I need to restart my phone for the changes to take effect—will restarting my phone cause me to lose any of my photos or messages? I just want to be sure before I do anything.

I restarted my phone like you said, but I still can’t send picture messages. It’s still not working, and I’m getting a bit more frustrated. Is there anything else we can try? I really need to send these photos.

I checked, and it looks like my messaging app only has permission for the phone—it doesn’t have permission for storage or SMS. Should I go ahead and give it those permissions? Will that help with sending picture messages?

I’ve given the messaging app permission for both storage and SMS, but I still can’t send picture messages. It’s still not working. Is there anything else we can try? I really hope we can fix this soon.

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.
